quote: This Agreement is governed by the laws of Malaysia.
policy_quote: Governing law must be a jurisdiction with mature data protection law (England & Wales, Ireland, US Delaware, or similar). Avoid jurisdictions with weak enforcement. Violation: governing law in a jurisdiction without recognised data protection regime.
reason: Malaysia is not a named jurisdiction. It has a personal-data statute, so it is not clearly 'a jurisdiction without a recognised data protection regime,' which is the listed violation. The policy's 'or similar' test is a legal judgement. Do not mark this a violation without legal review.
suggested_fix: Confirm with legal whether Malaysian law is acceptable. If not, move governing law to England & Wales, Ireland, or Delaware.
